concepts.definition: Discrete executable units: step_in, plant, pivot, reach, strike_like, dodge, recoil, fall, recovery, grab — the shared language between extraction and generation
concepts.name: Action-atom vocabulary

concepts.definition: Smears, impact flashes, speed lines, motion echo, energy trails, dust, held/repeated frames, background abstraction — timed events attached to actions, separable from physical motion
concepts.name: Anime VFX event layer

concepts.definition: Decompose video to the smallest TRANSFER-USEFUL units (one gaze shift, one foot plant, one caption pop) — each atom carries time, type, subject, value, evidence class, confidence, provenance
concepts.name: Atomic deconstruction

concepts.definition: Asset -> Sequence -> Scene -> Shot -> Beat -> Action -> Motion primitive -> Micro-event -> Frame, with 11 cross-cutting layers so one phrase never smears acting+camera+marketing together
concepts.name: 9-level atomic ontology

concepts.definition: What makes video read creator-made: direct lens address, casual environment, self-correction, incomplete sentences, off-axis gaze, handling noise, unpolished transitions — identifiable semantically, quantifiable by measurement
concepts.name: Authenticity cue inventory

concepts.definition: Models render one continuous ~4-8s shot; split the ad one clip per beat, trim, hard jump cuts — the cuts ARE authentic UGC
concepts.name: Beat-per-clip build

concepts.definition: Explicit camera position/orientation over time — the shot path as data
concepts.name: Camera position keyframes

concepts.definition: Model input boxes cap ~2000 chars; compact combined formats carry every lever in one paste; verify with wc -c never eyeball
concepts.name: Char-budget discipline

concepts.definition: Analyze difficult passages independently via start/end times; Pegasus 1.5 clipping requires a MINIMUM 4-SECOND window — pad short events and resolve times back to source clock
concepts.name: Clipped analysis (4s minimum)

concepts.definition: hook -> problem -> product_reveal -> demonstration -> proof -> CTA with timing locks (product <3s, proof before CTA, CTA >=2.5s)
concepts.name: UGC communication graph

concepts.definition: Tier 1 text-only -> 2 key poses -> 3 pose-conditioned video -> 4 rigged animation intermediate (pose/mask/depth/flow control passes) -> 5 video-to-video appearance transfer. Exact movement normally needs Tier 3+
concepts.name: 5 compilation tiers

concepts.definition: contacts[] with region_a/region_b, start/end, type (impact|near_miss|grasp), tolerance_m — strikes land on time, hands don't phase through
concepts.name: Timed contact events

concepts.definition: Four separable layers: action content (walk->reach) / performance (hesitant, bound) / style transform (natural|anime|superhuman) / presentation (handheld close|locked wide). Collapsing them into one style_intensity scalar makes controlled transfer impossible
concepts.name: Content/performance/style/presentation separation

concepts.definition: Coupled artifacts grow/shrink together, deterministically: research package added -> alias + cards + CONCEPT_INDEX part + graph rebuild enforced; package removed -> dangling aliases/cards/index flagged with ordered REQUIRED ACTIONS; runbooks <-> routing table both directions; graph.json is derived and freshness-checked. sync_repo.py is the manager; gate check [10] blocks drift from ever committing
concepts.name: E2E control plane (sync contract)

concepts.definition: Naturalism = a LOW-FREQUENCY, task-aware, correlated variation process with limits + a seed (reproducible) — NOT independent random jitter per joint/frame, which produces vibration not life. Refines microvariation
concepts.name: Correlated variation, not white noise

concepts.definition: Pose, masks, depth, flow, camera paths live as video/arrays/BVH/glTF — never serialized into prose or bloated text formats; text carries semantics, media carries density
concepts.name: Dense signals stay as media

concepts.definition: A genuine smile = cheeks raise WITH the mouth (AU6+AU12); mouth-only smiles read fake/creepy
concepts.name: Duchenne smile rule

concepts.definition: Operationalize Laban from measurable motion: speed/accel -> Time, path directness -> Space, smoothness/jerk -> Flow, vertical drop/impact -> Weight — turns the effort WORDS into computable/checkable quantities
concepts.name: Laban effort computational proxies

concepts.definition: Per-interval weight/time/space/flow in [-1,1] — movement QUALITY as numbers per beat
concepts.name: Laban effort as numeric vectors

concepts.definition: measured / detected / inferred / interpreted / authored — every claim typed by how it was obtained; Pegasus enters as interpreted/inferred, never measured
concepts.name: Evidence classes

concepts.definition: Pick the carrier by fidelity need: semantic->text prompt; key poses->sparse frames; exact screen-space body->pose-control video; editable contact/balance->rigged animation+IK; precise camera->camera trajectory; exact masks->segmentation video; stylized timing->edit/compositor package
concepts.name: Execution carrier selection

concepts.definition: Eye darts, gentle blinks, brow flickers, cheek/lip micro-shifts, talking mouth shapes, head bobs synced to speech — never a frozen face
concepts.name: Alive face-motion layer

concepts.definition: Face as a SEQUENCE of AU events with start/end (brow-raise -> knit -> sharpen -> soften), intensities B-C, translated to plain language for the model
concepts.name: Timed FACS event sequence

concepts.definition: 12 named failures with fixes: truncated JSON -> reduce scope; timestamp drift -> snap; identity swap -> masks+review; false contact -> ambiguous class; UGC too polished -> enforce imperfections; motion not reproduced -> escalate tier; identity leak -> neutral render
concepts.name: Failure-mode -> deterministic-response table

concepts.definition: realism / skin / motion / adherence 1-5 per run — the lab's working subset of the 8-layer fidelity model
concepts.name: Lab rating dimensions

concepts.definition: Each format owns the controls it does best: YAML = creative intent, style extends:, Laban words, affect, marketing, safety, high-level constraints (human-readable+inheritable). JSON = kinematics, contacts, camera 6DoF, verification, provenance (exact machine-validated arrays). XML = ordered script, FACS/gaze/breath event triggers, VFX+audio cues via namespaces (ordered mixed content). JSONL = evidence stream; dense signals stay media. XML references the JSON by hash — one authority per quantity
concepts.name: Format-to-control assignment (YAML=intent, JSON=precision, XML=order/triggers)

concepts.definition: Curate the format combo by user intent (exact motion=JSON only; tweak-style-myself=YAML->JSON; script+SFX cues=XML+JSON; semantic-first=YAML+XML; full production=tri; options=spread+NL), then merge under the laws: one authority per quantity, XML references JSON by sha256 never restates numbers, YAML resolves down into JSON, JSON wins conflicts with a REPORT, locks survive merges, typed merges only, one shared clock
concepts.name: Format mixing compiler (curate 2/3/4-format packages)

concepts.definition: The SAME semantic prompt in different serializations (NL / YAML / XML / JSON / YAML+JSON / YAML+XML / JSON+XML) renders DIFFERENT model outputs. Format is NOT a quality lever (p006 — it doesn't systematically raise realism) but IS a diversity lever: swap format to generate output VARIANCE for A/B and selection. Owner explicitly values this
concepts.name: Format as a diversity lever

concepts.definition: Precise/anime timing as explicit FRAME accounting: per-beat frame sums that validate (240 = 36+36+36+48+48+36), exposure notation (1s/2s/3s = frames-per-drawing), per-strike anticipation_f -> contact_f -> follow_through_f -> hold_f breakdowns summing exactly, held-impact minimum (>=4 frames). Timing you can verify, not vibe
concepts.name: Frame-budget math

concepts.definition: Machine-checkable rules in the score: identity lock >=0.95, no slow-mo, no vfx, cuts==0, contact tolerance — with failure metrics
concepts.name: Hard constraints + verification block

concepts.definition: Compact combined formats <2000 chars; structure keeps levers organized but the model reads the descriptive content — format is not realism
concepts.name: House formats: YAML-in-XML / YAML+JSON

concepts.definition: Every pipeline hop declares what is retained, compressed, inferred, or discarded (video->Pegasus loses trajectories; video->detectors loses intention) — the discipline that makes fusion honest
concepts.name: Information-preservation accounting

concepts.definition: 30fps, Smart-HDR flat tone, cool WB, deep focus/no bokeh, floaty stabilization, AF/AE breathing — makes footage read as a real phone video, not cinema
concepts.name: iPhone-12 capture signature

concepts.definition: Explicit joint keyframes + timed contacts + effort vectors + camera keyframes — drives precise, tracked, identity-locked motion prose cannot specify; JSON alone can be sufficient
concepts.name: Numeric canonical-truth paradigm

concepts.definition: Weight/Time/Space/Flow qualities (light/sudden/direct/free...) + Shape (advancing/enclosing) — movement quality vocabulary, descriptive form
concepts.name: Laban efforts (words)

concepts.definition: The canonical stack for ANY motion control: L1 intent, L2 action graph, L3 phase (global+local per-bone), L4 root/balance, L5 joint kinematics, L6 contact, L7 dynamics, L8 Laban/BESS, L9 face/affect, L10 mannerism, L11 secondary, L12 stylization/VFX, L13 presentation (camera/edit/audio), L14 verification — on a spine (identity/time/coords/authority/rights) with 3 format skeletons: YAML authors intent, JSON carries canonical numbers, XML carries ordered script+triggers. Coverage-audited against all 3 papers
concepts.name: 14-layer universal motion skeleton (x3 formats)

concepts.definition: Telling-a-friend energy, small 'um', one glance away, a shrug — over-direction reads as a paid actor
concepts.name: Loose casual delivery

concepts.definition: time-to-first-face/-lens-address/-product/-result, product visibility DUTY CYCLE, caption density, cut count, proof-before-claim, CTA start+duration — descriptive testable variables, not conversion guarantees
concepts.name: Measurable marketing variables

concepts.definition: SAM 2 (promptable mask tracking), OpenPose-class (multi-person 2D pose), RAFT (dense optical flow), EMOCA (3D face + affect), audio word-times — the reproducible lane Pegasus fuses with
concepts.name: Named measurement stack

concepts.definition: Small motion irregularity (microvariation ~0.05) prevents robotic sameness; never fully still
concepts.name: Microvariation / biological noise

concepts.definition: Pass 0 source map -> 1 scenes/shots -> 2 narrative beats -> 3 camera+edit -> 4 performance -> 5 visible actions -> 6 VFX+audio -> 7 contradiction QC. Narrow aligned passes beat one giant prompt
concepts.name: 8-pass Pegasus strategy

concepts.definition: Agents drift to NL-only prompting; here NL-only is illegal as a default. Deliver the structured format the control demands (fight/motion=JSON, intent/style=YAML, script/triggers=XML, combos for full production). NL is an OPTION delivered transparently as one labeled variant ALONGSIDE the structured forms — and emitting the same content as NL+YAML+XML+JSON is the elite A/B spread (format variance, p009)
concepts.name: Never default to natural language (format discipline)

concepts.definition: Normal cluttered room, flat overhead light, no styled set, no golden-hour glow
concepts.name: Ordinary un-staged setting

concepts.definition: Every action has onset -> anticipation apex -> acceleration -> max extension -> min target distance -> impact accent -> follow-through -> recovery -> settle; complex actions need per-limb local phases
concepts.name: Action phase landmarks

concepts.definition: Close slightly boomy front-mic, room echo, faint hum, breath before the line, no music — studio-clean audio betrays the fake
concepts.name: Phone-mic audio realism

concepts.definition: Reusable versioned defaults per axis (movement/capture/camera/performance/screen_action/style) that an authoring doc inherits then overrides; precedence = local override > specific scope > profile default; hard_constraints never silently drop. Compiler-backed form of blocks
concepts.name: profile:// modular profile system

concepts.definition: The model reads descriptive text; structured formats are packaging — best for look, skin, vibe, performance feel
concepts.name: Descriptive-prose control paradigm

concepts.definition: Declare what must NOT change under a style transform: action identity+order, participant/target identity, support/contact topology, safety class, shot purpose, critical gaze/product visibility, start/end state, locked dialogue, recovery destination. Style deviations are then explainable
concepts.name: Protected invariants (survive stylization)

concepts.definition: Infer a structured directorial score FROM a finished video (video -> estimated intention + control tracks); explicitly underdetermined — alternatives recorded, not resolved away
concepts.name: Reverse Directorial Compilation

concepts.definition: (no on-screen text, no subtitles, no watermark) — keeps captions for the edit; product only when the beat calls for it
concepts.name: Render negatives

concepts.definition: lab/graph.json — a DERIVED graph over cards, blocks, patterns, runs, variants, runbooks, layers, and papers (158+ nodes). Traverse with scripts/graph.py: neighbors (expand pantry), path (explain intent->format compilation routes), clusters (cuisines), walk --seed (deterministic creative walks that surface non-obvious ingredient combos). Never hand-edited; regenerated by build_graph.py; freshness gate-enforced
concepts.name: Repo knowledge graph (derived, traversable)

concepts.definition: Pegasus structured responses: the JSON Schema WINS over a conflicting prompt; validate client-side; check finish_reason for truncation; one analysis mode per batch
concepts.name: Schema-over-prompt precedence

concepts.definition: Choreographed timed expression+gesture beats — polished AD feel with high production value
concepts.name: Scored FACS/Laban beat sequence

concepts.definition: Name real skin features (fine pores, uneven tone, fine lines, under-eye puffiness, T-zone sheen) AND forbid smooth_ai_skin/waxy/poreless — never ask for 'smooth'
concepts.name: Real-skin microtexture recipe

concepts.definition: For image-to-video, ONE still locks identity + skin texture; the video prompt cannot fix a waxy still; reuse the same still across all clips
concepts.name: Reference-still identity anchor

concepts.definition: Style = a source_profile->target_profile transform with NAMED dimensions (timing_compression, anticipation_expansion, key_pose_hold_frames, arc_exaggeration, silhouette_separation, secondary_overlap, microvariation, graphic_smear, impact_frame, camera_emphasis) + invariants — never one style_intensity scalar
concepts.name: Typed style-transform vector

concepts.definition: Superhuman motion = declared virtual-physics changes by PHASE (gravity_scale_by_phase, propulsion_impulse_scale, drag_scale, landing_response_scale) + stylized_deformation (reach/perspective extension) + presentation time-scales, with human-readable invariants (takeoff/landing contact, target readability, recovery). State WHERE energy enters and HOW it is shown separately
concepts.name: Superhuman as constrained transformation

concepts.definition: Three logically separate roles: authoring agent PROPOSES yaml, compiler RESOLVES+validates, verifier MEASURES. Never let one model silently do all three and hide its assumptions
concepts.name: Authoring / compiler / verifier separation

concepts.definition: When output timing/math/feel is wrong, turn the ONE owning field instead of regenerating blind: hit late=contacts[].start_f; weak punch=anticipation+impact_hold+reaction_impulse+shake+db+weight; floaty=gravity_scale+support check; robotic=correlated microvariation+local-phase lag; sliding feet=root-vs-support earliest causal layer; wrong order=temporal_relations/XML order; style not landing=one-dimension ablation; ignored numbers=escalate density or carrier. One field per iteration, log the run
concepts.name: Tinkering map (symptom -> field -> format)

concepts.definition: Split a shot into an AUTHORING doc (semantic intent: 'right punch -> left parry', human/agent-authored, YAML) and a KINEMATIC CANONICAL doc (xyz joint trajectories, typed contacts, continuous-float Laban, camera path, provenance, verification metrics, JSON). Different concerns, different consumers, ONE clock. The JSON alone can drive generation (r005)
concepts.name: Two-document architecture (authoring + kinematic canonical)

concepts.definition: Valence/arousal/control as an arc over the clip, with experienced state separate from displayed performance (concealment, social smiles)
concepts.name: Affect as trajectory (experienced vs displayed)
